stories.title: Dog killed in Vernal shooting, alleged gunman arrested on suspicion of attempted murder
stories.summary: A man who police say fired four rounds at another man's trailer, killing a dog inside, has been arrested.

stories.title: Wanted fugitive arrested after crashing stolen car in Midvale
stories.summary: A man with a lengthy criminal history and an outstanding arrest warrant was arrested Sunday night and accused of crashing a stolen car in Midvale.

stories.title: Johnny Depp film 'Ebenezer' gets actor first No. 1 opening in 8 years
stories.summary: Johnny Depp is back at the top of the box office with his first studio movie in eight years, and since fallout from a contentious libel trial against ex-wife Amber Heard left his future in Hollywood in jeopardy.

stories.title: Utah's on-time graduation rate gains are the highest in the country
stories.summary: Utah recorded the largest national gain in on-time bachelor's degree graduation rates, rising from 28% to 37%, according to the Strada Education Foundation's annual State Opportunity Index.

stories.title: Josh Furlong's AP Top 25: Georgia likely the team to beat, but UCLA and Utah making a case
stories.summary: As we close in on the end of the regular season, there's very few certainties in the sport.

stories.title: Speed being investigated as factor in fatal motorcycle crash
stories.summary: A motorcyclist was killed in a collision with a car making a left turn in Salt Lake City Sunday night.

stories.title: Lindsay Clancy's retrial scheduled for March 2027
stories.summary: Lindsay Clancy, the Massachusetts mother who argues she should not be held criminally responsible for killing her three children, is slated to face a second trial beginning on March 29, 2027, less than a year after her first trial ended with a hung jury.

stories.title: Robert Pattinson is named the 7th James Bond, taking over the role from Daniel Craig
stories.summary: Robert Pattinson has been cast as the seventh actor to portray James Bond in the franchise's 26th film, marking the first installment under Amazon MGM Studios' creative control.

stories.title: Freeman Johnson, the oldest of the dwindling number of Pearl Harbor survivors, dies at 106
stories.summary: Freeman Johnson, the oldest of the few remaining Pearl Harbor survivors, has died.

stories.title: 4-story building project on Salt Lake City's Main Street gets approval for another $2 million loan
stories.summary: The four-story food and entertainment hub would be at the site of the Los Tapatios and London Belle that burned down in 2025.

stories.title: Killer drones face a reckoning as UN conference of nations considers rules on lethal AI weapons
stories.summary: U.N. delegates are debating whether to begin negotiations on international rules governing autonomous weapons as concerns grow over the use of AI-powered drones and machines in warfare.

stories.title: Raye leads 2027 Grammy nominations, followed by Rosalía, Ella Langley, Olivia Rodrigo and more
stories.summary: Call her a Raye of sunshine. The English singer-songwriter leads the 2027 Grammy Award nominations, the Recording Academy announced Monday.
